FIELDS.NAME: Blissful Bridal Boutique
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Blissful Bridal Boutique, we specialize in providing a personalized shopping experience for couples preparing for their wedding. Our operations include a curated selection of wedding dresses, bridesmaid dresses, and formalwear, ensuring that our clients have access to the latest trends and styles. We offer consultations and fittings by appointment, creating a welcoming and tailored environment for our customers. Our knowledgeable staff, including experienced seamstresses, is dedicated to providing excellent customer service and high-quality alterations.

To ensure a smooth operation, we maintain a strong inventory turnover management strategy, regularly reviewing stock levels and sourcing our products from a mix of reputable vendors to minimize supply chain disruptions. Our boutique is located in a safe area, allowing us to focus on providing a comfortable shopping experience. As we continue to grow, we are committed to staying compliant with all local regulations and enhancing our operational practices in line with industry best standards.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 5, 2023, a burst pipe in the storage room caused water damage to some wedding dresses and accessories, resulting in a loss amounting to $1,500. The damage was assessed, and all affected items have since been repaired or replaced, with the claim fully processed and closed.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 10:00 AM - 7:00 PM; Saturday: 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class 1, Grade 0, Secured with biometric access and 24/7 monitoring.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm system with 24/7 monitoring and security patrols during high-traffic events.
